name: perchlight-guard
description: A free, self-hosted Cloudflare Worker that warns you before you hit a Cloudflare free-plan (or Workers Paid) limit, or GitHub Actions' free allowance.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Required. A Cloudflare API token with **Account > Account Analytics > Read** only (dashboard > My Profile > API Tokens > Create Token > Custom). Read-only: it can't change anything.

STATUS_PASSWORD.description: Required. A password (12+ characters) for the status page at `/`. Any user name works.

WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. A Discord, Slack or ntfy webhook URL for alerts (set WEBHOOK_FORMAT to match). Leave empty for email only.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional. A **classic** GitHub personal access token with the `user` scope, to watch GitHub Actions usage (set GITHUB_USER too). Leave empty to skip GitHub.
